messages.subject: load required packages during rhmr setup
parts:
Not sure if this has been answered.. when I tried to load a package in
rhmr setup, it seems the standard output message is regarded as errors
thus aborted the job:

Error in rhex(mr) :
ERROR

R ERROR BEGIN (map.setup):
=============

randomForest 4.6-2

R ERROR END
===========


Here is how my setup argument look like:

setup = expression({load("model.Rdata");library(randomForest,
logical.return = TRUE)})

I also tried require(randomForest, quietly = TRUE), but just not able
to get rid of those messages...

Any suggestions to get around of it?
